game.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
game.blurb: Action RPG reimagining of Final Fantasy VII, set in the city of Midgar, from Square Enix, released 2020-04-10. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1462040)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_VII_Remake
Fandom (finalfantasy.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Final_Fantasy_VII_Remake
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 2, but only two walkthrough subpages exist ("The Destruction of Mako Reactor 1", about 1,200 characters, and "Fateful Encounters", about 340); the Walkthrough page itself is missing, so it is not a real guide and no structure was taken. finalfantasy.fandom.com answers the API, with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE (1462040), which includes the INTERmission episode; the Steam schema calls it "ENDplusP" (an internal codename). 32 of 63 Steam achievements are hidden. The 8 hidden ones listed after "Hardened Veteran", around the visible INTERmission achievement, were put in the INTERmission chapter by schema position. The rest sit in the main story chapter; "Say It with Flowers", "Dancing Queen", "Divine Gratitude", "The Johnny Experience", "That's the Smell" and "Ultimate Weapon" are probably optional content and need checking. "In Lockstep" (Mako Reactor 5) was put in the main story.
